notes.title: 🍀March 2025 - Dev Log Updates🍀
notes.content:
Hey, y'all - hope you're doing well in the new quarter. We've made some updates to the game to fix issues across systems over the past month and change!

[h1]💻Dev Log[/h1]
[list]
[*] 🎮[b]Design:[/b] Fixed missing / floating wall issues for arenas on Lv. 1 Adult, update player out of bounds to prevent boundary breaks on Level 1
[*] 🔉[b]Audio:[/b] modified mixes in FMOD (English, Japanese, Spanish book audio mixes) and fixed audio triggering (double jump emote, footstep SFX)
[*] ⚔️[b]Combat Physics: [/b]edited enemy bird's fireball physics to prevent wall passing
[*] 🐲[b]Boss Fights[/b]: Removed the Spider Dragon's current anomalous chomp sound (they're not a biter [for now!])
[*] 🛠️[b]Refactoring[/b] and cleaning of code post launch e.g. PlayerController, messaging of events, timer tools for design mods, etc. We're hoping this'll make it easier to get great, big changes out to y'all :)
[/list]
With love 💖,
- The Trashfire Team

notes.title: Version 2.2.1 Update
notes.content:
Hello all! Now that we have officially entered release, we can only hope to grow from here. We want to express our gratitude to the community and hope to see you on all future prospects. We will continue polishing the game and also begin to keep more formal versioning. For our first round of release updates on "An Eternity Gone By" we include:

[b]Audio[/b]
- Fixing the extremely quiet audio after the temple level
- Fixed bug where temple sfx did not close after time traveling
- Removing the ambient noise that played as an adult in houses

[b]Gameplay/Design[/b]
- Upgrading the speed at which orbs eject from treasure chests
- Added better feedback so that heals make player glow green and shields glow blue
- Added collision to mountains that were missing it
- Added optimizations to flash rendering

[b]UI[/b]
- Fixing a bug where toggling the information pin in the pause menu caused the player to leave the pause menu
- Fixing a bug where clicking off the pause menu with a mouse breaks everything and only lets you pause again
- Fixed the scale, resolution, and anchors on the credits scene
- Added a new Voice FX slider if you want to make Mirai quieter

[b]Misc.[/b]
- Fixed some trees floating in level 2
- Changed snail trail from yellow to purple because level 3 made it difficult to see it
- Fixed elder Mirai's ragdoll so that she falls properly and doesn't stretch strangely

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44949381/607931891e351778eb862b008ec896f163bdc6e0.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44949381/fc1e433f43dfe515b5bb6a8643f6ec1a7826bb56.png[/img][/url]

With love,
Trashfire Games

notes.title: December 2024 - Dev Log Updates
notes.content:
[h1]🎇Seasons Greetings![/h1]

Hey, y'all - happy (almost) New Year! Below is our Devlog update from the month of December! We've hit some delays this past month with the Holidays, but are working hard to get the game out in the best shape possible in the new year 😤

[h1]💻December Dev Log Changes [/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed item configs on plates, pans, knives, and pots
[*] Fine tuned treasure chest animations and extended their use
[*] Optimized draw calls on object outlines
[*] Optimized the filesize of many objects by switching from stereo to mono
[*] Gave the boat a float floor
[*] Added a ton of new sounds e.g. for: XL pineapple, jug, vases, columns, table, cups, beehives, pickaxes, mine carts, chimney, barrel, hammers, suitcases, crystals, and shells
[/list]

With love 💖,
- The Trashfire Team

notes.title: October 2024 - Steam Next Fest, January Release, Dev Log
notes.content:
[h1]🎉 We're in Steam Next Fest![/h1]

After months of hard work, we’re thrilled to announce that [i]An Eternity Gone By[/i] is part of this October's Steam Next Fest! 🤠🃏

📥 If you haven't already, feel free to give us a wishlist to stay tuned for the full-release!
🎮 Have fun playing the demo, and enjoy the Fest!

[h1]🗓️ Set your calendars for a January release! [/h1]

We also wanted to update you all that we are pushing the release date of [i]An Eternity Gone By[/i] from November to January. 

We know it's important to keep a quality bar, and so the team is taking the team to give the game the love and polish it needs to give you the best play experience!

[h1]💻October Dev Change Log [/h1]

In addition, the dev team is continuing to update the game as we work towards launch. Below are the changes from the past month - we're going to make this the best game we can, y'all 😤

[h3]Major Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Rebalanced the 240 prefabs in the game for a better combat experience
[*] Reorganized the 30 market place stalls to balance variety better
[*] Redid the settings menu from scratch to make it much cleaner
[/list]
[h3]Minor Updates[/h3]
[list]
[*] Gave Mirai a new illusory trail when she bends space to dash forward
[*] Adjust the height that many large objects are raised up
[*] Add ragdoll to enemy clock
[*] Did a palette swap on the firebird to make it more "fire"
[*] Update the objective text with a more readable background and new fadeout
[*] Updated the compass and timer UI to be a little cleaner; new version incoming soon
[*] Extended DPad controls to now work on UI
[*] Upscaled some food items for better hitboxes
[*] Add new audio stinger at combat start
[*] Added new sfx on pause menu, skill menu, hand weights, and benches
[*] Redid the wood textures to look nicer
[*] Changed snail trail color to purple to give it more contrast
[*] Updated game over text
[*] Used better compression on storybook panels to reduce used storage space
[*] Started using better versioning so that player log shows game version
[/list]
[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed layers on too many level 2 objects to list them
[*] Fixed missing sound on literally hundreds of rocks
[*] Patched many of the holes present on mesh bottoms
[*] Fixed bug where looking up/down slowed down run speed
[*] Fixed bug where storybook used wrong control scheme
[*] Fixed collectible to use fixed updates and improve interpolation/attraction logic
[*] Fixed UV and shader on waterfall
[*] Fixed bug where controller does not click SFX on UI buttons
[*] Fix missing pumpkin stem
[*] Fixed bug where water audio didn't play
[*] Fixed missing references on Blazebeak
[/list]
That's all for now, folks!

With love 💖,
- The Trashfire Team
